out.title: Infosys completes Syngenta global SAP S/4HANA transformation go-live
out.summary: Infosys announced successful go-live of Syngenta's Crop Protection Core SAP S/4HANA transformation, a unified digital core supporting 10,000+ employees across 80 countries, built with Infosys Topaz and Cobalt. Promotional, no financials.
